content: AI review fatigue 2026: 5-10x code output shifts bottleneck to human review (teams at 50-100 PRs/week); template blindness causes skimming; separate-dashboard review tools add context-switch overhead — review must live in the workflow. Desired features: risk-based routing (docs fast-tracked, API/auth changes deep review), AI-generated change summaries with risk assessment per PR, human judgment reserved for spec approval, conditional approval. Alert fatigue governance (few, accurate notifications) is a repeated theme.
